tags.name: River Raisin Marina & Campground
tags.note: The River Raisin Marina & Campground is ideally located on the north side of the Port of Monroe Turning Basin, on the River Raisin in Monroe, MI. This location allows for deep water access (22 feet) into Lake Erie from the well protected waters.

tags.seamark:information: Secured with a two point spar mooring system with same light characteristics.
